verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships built-in metrics you can enable through configuration. Community reports describe Whisker, a live debugger that shows the pipeline graph and traces frames in real time. These are raw signals and debugging tools, though, and the pack shows no production call-monitoring dashboard or alerting. Missing for 10: production live-call monitoring dashboard, alerting on agent misbehavior or error-rate spikes, evidence of metrics export to observability or alerting systems, independent hands-on production monitoring reports.
